hints.title: Digit-by-Digit Progression
hints.text: Construct numbers digit by digit. Each subsequent digit must differ from the previous digit by exactly k.

hints.title: Level-Wise Number Extension
hints.text: Begin with all single-digit non-zero numbers 1 through 9. At each length level, append valid next digits to every number.

hints.title: BFS Frontier Maintenance
hints.text: Initialize queue with digits 1 through 9. Repeat n - 1 times: for each num, last_digit = num % 10. Candidates are last_digit + k and last_digit - k. If in [0, 9], push num * 10 + candidate. Deduplicate candidates when k == 0.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of digits in target integer
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning all 10^N integers to check consecutive differences takes exponential time for N up to 9.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Generating only valid numbers directly branches at most 2 ways per digit, visiting at most 9 * 2^(N - 1) states.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle k = 0 cleanly to avoid generating duplicate numbers.
complexity.notes: Leading zero numbers like 07 are prohibited unless N is 1.
